text: Westport Albion quickly recovers possession near their left side, deep in their own half. Marek Zielinski intercepts and passes short to Jonah Valdez, who carries the ball forward through the centre. Valdez moves the ball rightward and then feeds Dylan Rahman, who crosses into the penalty area from the right flank. Valdez meets the ball with a header inside the six-metre box in front of the Kingsmoor FC goal at the far end, but goalkeeper Tariq Brennan dives to his left and makes a sharp save to deny the chance, keeping Westport Albion in the lead 3-2 [#1464] [#1465] [#1466] [#1467] [#1468] [#1469] [#1470] [#1471].
